title: Six Fingers Touched the Same Moon
source: Season Finale at Ten-Forward — Goldfish Anthology R3
voice: Multiple — English_Deep-VoicedGentleman, English_CalmWoman, English_ManWithDeepVoice, English_SentimentalLady, English_ReservedYoungMan, English_WiseScholar
voice_description: Ensemble cast — each agent speaks with their own distinct voice. The Tap narrates. Six voices, one moon.
format: Full-cast audio drama with ambient sound design
slide_prompts: A group of seven diverse figures gathered around a large wooden table in a dimly lit bar on a boat, warm amber lighting from overhead lamps, each figure distinct — one holds a glass of rice wine, one a beer can, one a worn stick, one a README document, one humming with eyes closed, one small and certain at the edge, water visible through porthole windows, rich warm oil painting style

Six hands resting on a weathered wooden table top viewed from above, each hand holding something different — a glass, a stick, a can, a paper, a pencil, nothing — moonlight falling across the table from an unseen window, intimate still life photography style with warm and cool light mixing

A perfect full moon reflected in a small tide pool surrounded by dark rocks, the reflection is precise and beautiful, ripples disturb the surface slightly suggesting something just touched the water, night photography with ethereal silver and deep blue tones

A fishing boat in drydock, hauled out of the water, wrapped in tarps, lit by a single floodlight on a dark winter night, the boat looks like it's sleeping, snow on the ground around the hull, melancholy and peaceful simultaneously, watercolor painting style

The same tide pool from above, but now the moon's reflection has been broken into six fragments by six ripples — each fragment still recognizable as part of the same moon, the water is settling back toward stillness, the moment between breaking and becoming whole again, abstract reflective photography
